'''C-Family Protocol Heads''' were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] head parts for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], one of the two largest droid manufacturing companies in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
They were typical protocol style heads, equipped with [[Photoreceptor/Legends|binocular sensors]] and a cybot [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]]&mdash;namely the [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]].<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> They were made of [[Copper/Legends|copper]], [[Titanium/Legends|titanium carbide]] and [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]], which means they were not magnetic. They had med-low material durability and weighed around 11 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="DW">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>

Those heads were part of the famous [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]], and presumably its offshoots like the [[3PX-series protocol droid|3PX-series]] or [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series]].
